The diagrams would include objects like "GUI", "Controls", "Relief Valve", and "Flow Sensor", with directed arrows showing the flow of messages and interactions, including positive, negative, boundary, alt, and loop scenarios as required. The "expected" fields in the JSON test cases would correspond to the expected outcomes or behaviors depicted in the Sequence Diagrams.
